title: A Proposal for the Use of an Innovative Two-Stage PK-Clinical Adaptive Trial in Biosimilar Product Development
excerpt: This proposal describes an innovative two-stage adaptive trial design that combines pharmacokinetic (PK) and clinical endpoints for biosimilar product development, aligning with the FDA's recommended stepwise approach for biosimilar approval. The design aims to optimize the clinical development pathway by integrating early PK data with later-stage clinical efficacy and safety assessments. This adaptive approach potentially streamlines the biosimilar approval process while maintaining appropriate regulatory standards.
